_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: Session 48 was the First Light design sprint (10 PRs): the dashboard now greets you once a day with a public-domain California plein air painting — full-color reveal, read-aloud, and an anonymous thought-for-the-day box (stored write-only; nobody can read them back except the service role). The visual spec for the coming dashboard re-theme is locked and BLESSED (prototype v1.4.2: monochrome + crimson/cobalt/hunter/violet/mustard, glass chrome, solid uniform chips). Next big Fable move: paint the live dashboard in the new theme. On the data side: Sam CURED all 11 shared Common SUBJ codes (2026-06-12) — the sweep is now alias-aware so convergence pairs stop flagging — and the SUBJ4 fold dry-run is the next Fable move there. Smog residuals + merge queues remain the curator frontier.
